Real fontconfig caches of the folder /usr/share/fonts/aresos (package 31's
Space Grotesk, os/config/usr/share/fonts/aresos) for test_release28 (package 42),
made with fontconfig 2.17.0 (Fedora 44), fc-cache-32 and fc-cache-64, run as
`fc-cache-NN --sysroot=ROOT --system-only --really-force` over a stand-in root
holding only that folder and a fonts.conf naming /usr/share/fonts:
  50471fd4bd417ff5c0731b6a17aa3708-le32d4.cache-9  the 32-bit format (fc-cache-32)
  50471fd4bd417ff5c0731b6a17aa3708-le64.cache-9    the 64-bit format (fc-cache-64)
The name is the MD5 of the folder. Release 28's dry run (run 43832912792) built
caches of this folder with the same sizes (6752 and 9144 bytes). They let the
tests read real caches of both formats.
